storyKits.angle: The print window is a clock
storyKits.headline: Temporal Forces: ~61 days of printing left (est.)
storyKits.body: The 30-month model puts Temporal Forces's print window closing in roughly 61 days — 200 listings on the tape today. Already out of print and thinning with no reprint news: Sword & Shield, Rebel Clash, Champion's Path. Estimates, not announcements — TPC can reprint anything.
